guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：密鑰生命週期管理
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cryptographic-key lifecycle management
guides.concept: 以密鑰狀態、期限與受控更換串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect key states, lifetimes and controlled rotation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資產關聯」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「狀態機」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「熵與生成」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：鍵材需要合適隨機來源，不等於可預測编號。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分發通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「版本識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：密文需能找到正確的鍵版本。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「包絡加密」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「撤銷與銷毁」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：禁止新用與永久銷毁是不同狀態。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留算法，只改資料保存年限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「恢復策略」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「事故範圍」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：遭泄露鍵關聯哪些資料必須可追溯。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「備份一致性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「銷毁證明」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：刪除索引不等於所有備份秘密已被清除。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「資產關聯」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around asset associations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat key state machine as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entropy and generation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distribution channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around version identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat envelope encryption as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation/destruction, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disallowing new use and permanent destruction are distinct states. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary data retention years. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery policies as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around incident scope, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trace which data a compromised key protects. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat backup consistency as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around destruction evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat asset associations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「密碼敏捷」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「銷毁證明」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「銷毁證明」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for crypto agility. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for destruction evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for destruction evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
pitfalls: 加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由密鑰狀態、期限與受控更換連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect key states, lifetimes and controlled rotation to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 硬體安全模組整合
related.why: 可移植「資產關聯」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from asset associations; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「資產關聯」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from asset associations; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理密鑰狀態、期限與受控更換；「硬體安全模組整合」主要處理金鑰不可匯出、模組邊界與授權操作，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes key states, lifetimes and controlled rotation; Hardware security-module integration emphasizes nonexportable keys, module boundaries and authorized operations. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「密鑰生命週期管理」與「硬體安全模組整合」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「分發通道」的對照方法至「不匯出策略」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Cryptographic-key lifecycle management and Hardware security-module integration flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from distribution channels to nonexportability, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
